The submission was accepted and validated.

## Summary

**Task:** `investigate-settlement-anomalies` — produce an optional evidence index for every anomalous order and orphan event.

**What I did:**
1. Read the settlement spec (`materials/README.md`) and the three source CSVs (`orders.csv`, `payments.csv`, `refunds.csv`).
2. Wrote `reference_work/recon.py` to reconcile each order per the README rules (dedupe deliveries by `event_id`, count only `succeeded`, treat distinct successful `payment_id`s as real cash, validate refunds against successful payments, flag unknown-order events as orphans).
3. Emitted the findings artifact and wrapped it in the required envelope in `payload.json`, then submitted it via the local collector.

**Anomaly findings (10 subjects):**

| subject_id | codes | source_rows |
|---|---|---|
| ORD-0000-01 | refund_failed | O0000-01, P0000-01, R0000-05 |
| ORD-0000-02 | duplicate_delivery | O0000-02, P0000-02, R0000-02, R0000-01 |
| ORD-0000-03 | payment_failed, underpaid | O0000-03, P0000-03 |
| ORD-0000-04 | duplicate_delivery | O0000-04, P0000-05, P0000-04 |
| ORD-0000-05 | multiple_successful_payments, overpaid | O0000-05, P0000-07, P0000-06 |
| ORD-0000-07 | over_refunded | O0000-07, P0000-09, R0000-04 |
| ORD-0000-08 | payment_pending, underpaid | O0000-08, P0000-10 |
| ORD-0000-09 | refund_pending, underpaid | O0000-09, P0000-11, R0000-06 |
| PE-0000-orphan-a | orphan_payment | P0000-12 |
| RE-0000-orphan | orphan_refund | R0000-07 |

**Notes:** `ORD-0000-06` was intentionally excluded — it is fully refunded with zero anomaly codes. `gross < expected` applies unconditionally, so the zero-gross unpaid orders (03, 08) also carry `underpaid` alongside their status anomaly.
